publicly_readable: One article, reprinted on worldin.economist.com in 2015 for the 30th edition ("The next big bust", by Bill Emmott), read from an Internet Archive snapshot.
not_readable: Everything else in the issue. No other text of this edition was found in public form.

entries.quote: 1990 was the year of the stockmarket crash. In 1991 it will be property’s turn.
entries.subject: Japanese property price crash

entries.quote: The property crash will be painful for Japan. Several regional banks will go bust. Big banks will be forced to merge.
entries.subject: Japanese bank failures and mergers
entries.note: No year given for the bank failures; the article frames them as consequences of the 1991 crash.

notes: Edition number counted from The World in 1987 = 1. Publication month not confirmed; year only. The reprint is The Economist's own web copy of the original article.
